query: Select all columns for users older than 30.
Select the name and surname of all users created in 2026.
response: SELECT name, surname FROM Users WHERE created_at = '2026-01-15 10:30:00';

query: Select all columns for orders that have not been delivered yet.
response: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE delivered_at IS NULL;

query: Count the total number of orders.
response: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders;

query: Select the order name and user name for all orders.
response: SELECT orders.name, users.name AS user_name FROM orders JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.id;
